text: がんばってね　わたしだけの　レッド！

structure.jp: わたしだけの　レッド！

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A て-form on its own at the end is a casual 'please do', the short version of てください. がんばってね = 'do your best, okay'

patterns.name: 〜だけ
patterns.explanation: だけ means 'only', and の makes it describe the next word. わたしだけの　レッド = 'the Red that is mine alone'
